announcements.programDescription: Carry over mei he ngaahi uike kuohili tukukehe kapau kuo 'osi 'a e 'aho. Ko e ngaahi fanongonongo ta‘e‘aho ‘oku ‘ikai ‘aupito ke ‘osi.
